daily.today_energy: You're radiating main character energy today, Leo. The cosmos is giving you permission to take up space and be unapologetically yourself. Trust the vibe—it's magnetic.
daily.love: Someone's noticing your glow. Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, your authentic self is the real love language right now. No need to perform.
daily.career: Your ideas have wings today. This is your moment to pitch that thought you've been sitting on. The universe is backing your creative instincts hard.
daily.health: Your body's telling you something—listen to it. Moving with intention (even just a walk) will shift your whole energy. Rest isn't laziness; it's wisdom.

weekly.overview: This week's cosmic energy is inviting you to step into your power without needing permission from anyone. Venus is whispering that authenticity is your superpower right now, so lean into what makes you uniquely you.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled or solo, the vibe is about magnetic self-love. If someone's been on your mind, trust your gut—timing feels aligned. Either way, prioritize connections that actually energize you.
weekly.career: Your creative energy is peaked this week. Ideas you've been sitting on are ready to breathe. Don't wait for the perfect moment—show up as you are and watch how others respond to your genuine effort.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for movement that feels good, not punishing. Try activities that make you smile. Sleep matters more than usual right now, so honor that rest without guilt.
